title: Walsh-Hadamard Bent-Function Flat Spectrum of Even-Multiplicity Quadratic CNOT Carries
claims: For any even overlap multiplicity m = 2k >= 2 at modulus q = 4 (t = 2), the quadratic carry phase (-1)^{sum_{j<l} u_j u_l} is a maximally nonlinear bent Boolean function with completely flat Hadamard distribution P(w) = 2^{-2k} across all 2^{2k} outcomes.
For odd overlap multiplicity m = 2k + 1, the carry phase is semi-bent with P(w) = 2^{-2k} on half of the outcomes and 0 on the other half.
favorable_controls: Even overlap multiplicities m in {2, 4, 6} (bent, H = m bits)
Odd overlap multiplicities m in {3, 5} (semi-bent, H = m - 1 bits)
